changes.after:
After initial demographic and secondary research on the category. The team decided to go with four angles targeting women and one to men. Each angle was deeply targeted with micro moments from persona's life: third coffee by 11am, hot flushes at 2am, with creaky knees, or no longer wanting sex. I designed the page for libido which resonated the most with the TG.

After initial positive results in Italy, we quickly expanded to other EU markets (UK, NL, FR & US)
